text:
Morgan: quick check — canary pool `canary-eu-1` is showing SM% hitting ~96% and KV cache evictions spiking. anyone know which dashboard/panel to look at? i can only find global panels, want per-pool view.

Jay: on it. which model/pool exactly? canary-eu-1? can you add a sample trace id or timeframe? :eyes:

Morgan: yes canary-eu-1, spike started ~11:08 UTC. saw a tempo trace id `3e2f4a` around then. kv_evictions metric jumps in the same window.

Priya: panels to check -> GPU Utilization: "SM% heatmap (per-pool)" and Observability: "KV Cache / Evictions (per-pool)". quick link: https://grafana.redwood.io/d/xyZGpu/gpu-overview?orgId=1&var-pool=canary-eu-1

Ken: prometheus quick queries that help:
```
sum by(pool)(rate(kvcache_evictions_total[1m]))
avg_over_time(sm_util_percent[5m]) by(pool)
```
also check traces in Honeycomb: dataset `inference.requests` filter `pool=\"canary-eu-1\"`

Samira: sounds like the batch-size change from yesterday. @Sam did a CR bump to default batch_size? pinging Sam.

Sam: yup — bumped default batch_size 8 -> 12 in the canary rollout at 10:55 UTC. can revert the canary to 8 for 10 min to see if that stabilizes. reverting now.

deploy-bot: Revert started for service runtime-canary in canary-eu-1 (deploy id dbc123).

Priya: for alerts — current `kvcache-evictions-alert` fires at >50 evictions/min over 1m. we should either widen the window to 3m or increase threshold for canary pools. noisy alerts during rollouts keep waking SRE.

Jay: agree. Sam revert and we watch kv_hitrate/evictions and SM% for 15m. @Ken can you patch the alert temporarily?

Ken: patching alert rule now. proposed expr: `avg_over_time(rate(kvcache_evictions_total[1m])[3m]) > 80` and add `pool=~\"canary-.*\"` label so it only loosens for canaries. applying change.

Morgan: thanks. also can someone share an example trace link? i couldn't find the specific trace view.

Ken: trace link pattern: https://tempo.redwood.io/trace/3e2f4a (replace id). honeycomb quick: `filter pool=\"canary-eu-1\" and duration_ms > 200` then group by `model_name` to see which model had long tail.

Samira: if revert doesn't fix it we'll open a rollback PR + run a batch-size canary sweep. :thumbsup:

Sam: revert finished — new replica config with batch_size=8 is active. please ping if still noisy.

monitor-bot: Alert throttle cleared for kvcache-evictions-alert in canary-eu-1.

Morgan: looking now — SM% dropped to ~72%, kv evictions back to baseline. thanks everyone. i'll close after 30m of stable metrics.

Jay: created follow-up ticket RW-4789 to update canary batch ramp docs and add a pre-rollout checklist.

Ken: opened temp alert PR #987 for review to make the canary rule less sensitive during rollouts. please approve or suggest changes.

Morgan: ack, thanks all. :eyes:
